messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-out shot that moves from upper-body to full-body framing. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-out shot that moves from upper-body to full-body framing. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in the street and then walks slowly forward away from the camera.","camera":"Third-person rear view at roughly waist height, slowly pulling back to reveal more of the character's legs.","clothing":"Yellow cable-knit sweater, light blue jeans, and tan shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short hair styled in a small top knot or bun.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a broad build, seen from behind with his face not visible.","scene":"A cobblestone city street with brick and painted storefronts, street lamps, and a hanging Union Jack flag in hazy daylight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the character from behind in a street scene, with the camera starting around upper-body framing and slowly pulling back to reveal the full body. The character's blue hair, yellow cable-knit sweater, jeans, and general street setting remain consistent with the source, though the original front-facing gestures and facial expression are no longer visible because the camera is behind the subject.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a rear-view dolly-out shot starting from upper-body framing and ending in full-body framing, while preserving the person's appearance, expression, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the exact timing and progression of the original action were preserved, since the rear view obscures the original gestures.
unexpected_changes: The character's original front-facing hand gestures and facial expression are not visible in the rear view, making preservation of expression impossible to verify visually.
